"""KPI quotidiens par Entité et pour le Programme (Story 3.2, FR-11)."""

from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
from pathlib import Path

import polars as pl
import pytest

from tests.unit.domaine.constructeur import Flux
from usine.adaptateurs.journal import SourceJournal
from usine.config import charger_yaml
from usine.contrats.calcul import PERIMETRE_PROGRAMME, SCHEMA_KPI
from usine.contrats.calendrier import jours_ouvres
from usine.contrats.config import ConfigProgramme
from usine.contrats.erreurs import UsineErreur
from usine.contrats.schemas import valider
from usine.contrats.tickets import SCHEMA_TICKET_ETAT, Champ, TypeTicket
from usine.domaine.instantanes import instantane, tickets_etats
from usine.domaine.kpi import CODES_KPI, DIMENSIONS_KPI, kpi
from usine.generateur.journal import generer, serialiser_journal

RACINE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
ENTITES = ["ENT-A", "ENT-B"]


def _ts(jour: int, heure: int = 9) -> datetime:
    return datetime(2026, 10, jour, heure, tzinfo=UTC)


def _kpi(flux: Flux, jours: list[date], entites: list[str] = ENTITES) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return kpi(tickets_etats(flux.evenements, jours), entites)


def _val(
    table: pl.DataFrame, jour: date, perimetre: str, code: str, dimension: str = ""
) -> tuple[int, int]:
    lignes = table.filter(
        (pl.col("date") == jour)
        & (pl.col("perimetre") == perimetre)
        & (pl.col("code_kpi") == code)
        & (pl.col("dimension") == dimension)
    )
    assert lignes.height == 1
    return lignes.row(0, named=True)["numerateur"], lignes.row(0, named=True)["denominateur"]


def _cas_de_test(flux: Flux, cle: str, statut: str, phase: str = "recette", entite: str = "ENT-A"):
    flux.creer(
        cle,
        TypeTicket.cas_de_test,
        _ts(1),
        {Champ.statut_test: statut, Champ.phase: phase, Champ.entite: entite},
    )


def test_stock() -> None:
    flux = Flux()
    flux.anomalie("A-1", _ts(1))
    flux.anomalie("A-2", _ts(1))
    flux.anomalie("B-1", _ts(1), entite="ENT-B", gravite="majeure", statut="fermee")
    jour = date(2026, 10, 1)
    t = _kpi(flux, [jour])
    assert _val(t, jour, "ENT-A", "anomalies_ouvertes") == (2, 1)
    assert _val(t, jour, "ENT-B", "anomalies_ouvertes") == (0, 1)
    assert _val(t, jour, PERIMETRE_PROGRAMME, "anomalies_ouvertes") == (2, 1)
    assert _val(t, jour, PERIMETRE_PROGRAMME, "anomalies_ouvertes_gravite", "bloquante") == (2, 1)
    assert _val(t, jour, PERIMETRE_PROGRAMME, "anomalies_ouvertes_gravite", "majeure") == (0, 1)
    assert _val(t, jour, "ENT-A", "anomalies_ouvertes_phase", "recette") == (2, 1)


def test_flux_du_jour() -> None:
    flux = Flux()
    flux.anomalie("A-1", _ts(5))
    flux.transition("A-1", _ts(6), "nouvelle", "fermee")
    flux.transition("A-1", _ts(7, 8), "fermee", "nouvelle")
    flux.transition("A-1", _ts(7, 10), "nouvelle", "fermee")
    jours = [date(2026, 10, 5), date(2026, 10, 6), date(2026, 10, 7)]
    t = _kpi(flux, jours)
    assert [_val(t, j, "ENT-A", "entrees_jour")[0] for j in jours] == [1, 0, 1]
    assert [_val(t, j, "ENT-A", "sorties_jour")[0] for j in jours] == [0, 1, 1]


def test_fenetre_glissante() -> None:
    flux = Flux()
    for i, jour in enumerate([1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]):
        flux.anomalie(f"A-{i}", _ts(jour))
    jours = list(jours_ouvres(date(2026, 10, 1), date(2026, 10, 9)))
    t = _kpi(flux, jours)
    assert _val(t, date(2026, 10, 1), "ENT-A", "entrees_fenetre") == (1, 1)
    assert _val(t, date(2026, 10, 7), "ENT-A", "entrees_fenetre") == (5, 1)
    assert _val(t, date(2026, 10, 9), "ENT-A", "entrees_fenetre") == (5, 1)
    assert _val(t, date(2026, 10, 9), "ENT-A", "sorties_fenetre") == (0, 1)


def test_age_median_et_maximum() -> None:
    flux = Flux()
    flux.anomalie("A-1", _ts(1))
    flux.anomalie("A-2", _ts(2))
    jours = list(jours_ouvres(date(2026, 10, 1), date(2026, 10, 7)))
    t = _kpi(flux, jours)
    d = date(2026, 10, 7)
    assert _val(t, d, "ENT-A", "age_median_anomalies_ouvertes") == (7, 2)
    assert _val(t, d, "ENT-A", "age_max_anomalies_ouvertes") == (4, 1)
    assert _val(t, date(2026, 10, 1), "ENT-A", "age_max_anomalies_ouvertes") == (0, 1)


def test_age_part_de_la_reouverture() -> None:
    flux = Flux()
    flux.anomalie("A-1", _ts(1))
    flux.transition("A-1", _ts(5), "nouvelle", "fermee")
    flux.transition("A-1", _ts(8), "fermee", "nouvelle")
    jours = list(jours_ouvres(date(2026, 10, 1), date(2026, 10, 9)))
    t = _kpi(flux, jours)
    assert _val(t, date(2026, 10, 9), "ENT-A", "age_max_anomalies_ouvertes") == (1, 1)


def test_aucune_ouverte() -> None:
    flux = Flux()
    flux.anomalie("A-1", _ts(1), statut="fermee")
    d = date(2026, 10, 1)
    t = _kpi(flux, [d])
    assert _val(t, d, "ENT-A", "age_median_anomalies_ouvertes") == (0, 0)
    assert _val(t, d, "ENT-A", "age_max_anomalies_ouvertes") == (0, 0)


def test_taux() -> None:
    flux = Flux()
    for i, statut in enumerate(["ok"] * 3 + ["ko"] + ["non_execute"] * 2):
        _cas_de_test(flux, f"T-{i}", statut)
    d = date(2026, 10, 1)
    t = _kpi(flux, [d])
    assert _val(t, d, "ENT-A", "taux_ko_cas_de_test", "recette") == (1, 4)
    assert _val(t, d, "ENT-A", "taux_non_execution_cas_de_test", "recette") == (2, 6)
    assert _val(t, d, "ENT-A", "taux_ko_cas_de_test", "tnr") == (0, 0)
    assert _val(t, d, "ENT-A", "taux_non_execution_cas_de_test", "tnr") == (0, 0)


def test_certifications() -> None:
    flux = Flux()
    for cle, statut in [("C-1", "accordee"), ("C-2", "reservee"), ("C-3", "reservee")]:
        flux.creer(
            cle,
            TypeTicket.certification,
            _ts(1),
            {Champ.statut_certification: statut, Champ.entite: "ENT-A"},
        )
    d = date(2026, 10, 1)
    t = _kpi(flux, [d])
    assert _val(t, d, "ENT-A", "certifications", "accordee") == (1, 1)
    assert _val(t, d, "ENT-A", "certifications", "reservee") == (2, 1)
    assert _val(t, d, "ENT-A", "certifications", "refusee") == (0, 1)


def test_trou_de_dates() -> None:
    flux = Flux()
    flux.anomalie("A-1", _ts(5))
    etats = tickets_etats(flux.evenements, [date(2026, 10, 5), date(2026, 10, 7)])
    with pytest.raises(UsineErreur, match="2026-10-06"):
        kpi(etats, ENTITES)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("entites", [["ENT-A", "ENT-A"], [PERIMETRE_PROGRAMME]])
def test_entites_invalides(entites: list[str]) -> None:
    flux = Flux()
    flux.anomalie("A-1", _ts(5))
    etats = tickets_etats(flux.evenements, [date(2026, 10, 5)])
    with pytest.raises(UsineErreur, match=entites[0]):
        kpi(etats, entites)


def test_table_vide() -> None:
    vide = pl.DataFrame(schema=dict(SCHEMA_TICKET_ETAT.colonnes))
    t = kpi(vide, ENTITES)
    assert t.height == 0
    valider(t, SCHEMA_KPI)


def _journal(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[pl.DataFrame, pl.DataFrame]:
    config = charger_yaml(RACINE / "config" / "programme.yaml", ConfigProgramme)
    chemin = tmp_path / "journal.jsonl"
    chemin.write_bytes(serialiser_journal(generer(config, 42, date(2026, 10, 12))))
    source = SourceJournal(chemin)
    fin = source.entete.date_injection
    jours = list(jours_ouvres(date(2026, 9, 1), fin))
    etats = tickets_etats(list(source.evenements()), jours)
    return etats, kpi(etats, [e.code for e in config.entites])


def test_journal_du_generateur(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    etats, t = _journal(tmp_path)
    valider(t, SCHEMA_KPI)
    assert not any(dt.is_float() for dt in t.schema.values())
    assert t.equals(kpi(etats, ["ENT-A", "ENT-B"]))
    assert set(t.get_column("code_kpi")) == set(CODES_KPI)
    assert t.height > 0
    # Programme = somme des Entités pour les comptes.
    comptes = t.filter(
        pl.col("code_kpi").is_in(["anomalies_ouvertes", "entrees_jour", "sorties_jour"])
    )
    par_perimetre = comptes.group_by("date", "code_kpi", "perimetre").agg(
        pl.col("numerateur").sum()
    )
    prog = par_perimetre.filter(pl.col("perimetre") == PERIMETRE_PROGRAMME)
    ents = (
        par_perimetre.filter(pl.col("perimetre") != PERIMETRE_PROGRAMME)
        .group_by("date", "code_kpi")
        .agg(pl.col("numerateur").sum().alias("somme"))
    )
    joint = prog.join(ents, on=["date", "code_kpi"])
    assert joint.height == prog.height
    assert (joint["numerateur"] == joint["somme"]).all()
    # Stock total = Anomalies ouvertes de l'Instantané ; conservation du stock.
    inst = instantane(etats)
    ouvertes = (
        inst.filter(
            (pl.col("type_ticket") == "anomalie") & ~pl.col("statut").is_in(["fermee", "rejetee"])
        )
        .group_by("date")
        .agg(pl.col("nombre").sum())
    )
    stock = t.filter(
        (pl.col("perimetre") == PERIMETRE_PROGRAMME) & (pl.col("code_kpi") == "anomalies_ouvertes")
    ).select("date", pl.col("numerateur").alias("stock"))
    for jour, nombre in ouvertes.iter_rows():
        assert stock.filter(pl.col("date") == jour)["stock"].item() == nombre
    for perimetre in [*ENTITES, PERIMETRE_PROGRAMME]:
        precedent = 0
        for jour in sorted(set(t["date"])):
            stock_j = _val(t, jour, perimetre, "anomalies_ouvertes")[0]
            flux_j = _val(t, jour, perimetre, "entrees_jour")[0] - _val(
                t, jour, perimetre, "sorties_jour"
            )[0]
            assert stock_j - precedent == flux_j
            precedent = stock_j


def test_dimensions_du_catalogue() -> None:
    assert set(DIMENSIONS_KPI) == set(CODES_KPI)
    assert len(CODES_KPI) == 12
